detail: Later Sheffield history dates Pitchford’s initial idea to this month.
Pitchford proposes a psychiatry and abnormal-psychology forum on BIONET.
Price points to an existing newsgroup; Davis expresses interest.
The unmoderated psychiatry@mailbase.ac.uk list is announced.
March founding appears in Figley’s later CV; an April public announcement survives.
First newsletter records the board’s naming decision; PsychNet wording persists.
Eight lists grow from 1,993 to 2,250 subscriptions; figures overlap across people.
A volunteer team takes over production after Pitchford’s first three issues.
Pitchford appeals over the loss of Mailbase support.
Strategic Planning Committee, legal assistance and proposed campus are reported.
A commercial interim host is chosen.
March newsletter reports the final end of Mailbase connections.
Joining guide distinguishes open groups from credentialed professional forums.
State records date the filing of INTERPSYCH, INC.
June report names InterPsych and the trauma forum as founding sponsors.
Young describes a confrontation and forum-leader settlement.
Assessment-Psychometrics reports moving independently to St John’s.
Pitchford announces charter discussions for a broader confederation.
Editorial history dates the decision to continue independently to this month.
First surviving issue and the independent Scout notice document the new title.
Journal appears in the affiliated PsyCom.Net community, including Fisher’s forum essays.
New St John’s pages describe the multi-institutional consortium.
Figley’s editorial describes the InterPsych forum’s relationship to the journal.
Grohol discusses organisational limits; Dubovsky evaluates online consultation.
Zenhausern reports more than 45 affiliated lists.
Page footer dates an elected federation with autonomous forums.
Sheffield page names Greg Alter president, Dubovsky past president and Stamm president emeritus.
A maintained page explains how new forums join the federation.
Carbonell and Figley describe research nominations obtained through the network.
InterPsych.net directory includes revised entries in a 27-forum listing.
ISTSS still places two forums within InterPsych and names Figley president.
University directory and bylaws pages bear this date.
InterPsych-specific page update survives in a 2005 capture.
Education manuscript discusses InterPsych; BMJ editorial cites a newsletter item.
InterPsych.net is parked by this capture; no organisational end date follows.
The corporation remains in the active-entity dataset; operational status is unresolved.
